ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, focusing on recent cases and the state's response to allegations.
questions: What is the scale of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the state addressing these issues?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover patterns of fraud and the effectiveness of state measures to combat it, providing valuable information for policymakers and the public.
